svg.text: Design notes · editor
Layout follows Docs: Ada's chat on the left
(Hide chat toggles it), then slide
thumbnails, then the canvas. In the editor
the app sidebar is collapsed to its icon
rail.
Top bar: persona presence (“Ada can edit /
is editing… / suggested changes”), save
state with version (Saved · Unsaved changes
· Saving… · Not saved), Present (primary),
Export, chat toggle.
Thumbnails: click to select, drag or Alt+↑/↓
to reorder, ⌘D duplicates, Delete removes
(undoable), + New slide uses the current
layout. An amber “!” marks a slide whose
text doesn't fit.
The toolbar is contextual. Undo/redo (⌘Z /
⇧⌘Z), Insert and Layout are always there.
With text selected it shows font slot, size,
B/I/U (⌘B/⌘I/⌘U), colour from the theme
tokens, alignment and bullets. With a shape
selected: fill, stroke and width. With
nothing selected: deck Theme and slide
Background.
Selection: frame, 8 handles and a rotate
handle. Arrow keys nudge 8 units (⇧ 40).
Enter edits the text in place; Esc leaves
text, then deselects. Tab cycles elements in
paint order. The chip shows type · role · id
for debugging.
Canvas: the SVG renderer from the shared
layout module, so it matches Present, PDF
and PPTX. It scales to fit the available
width, with a minimum of 480px before the
narrow layout takes over.
Speaker notes under the canvas: plain text,
exported to PPTX notes.
